keyEvents.text: Goal! Cardiff City 0, Burnley 1. Andréas Hountondji (Burnley) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lucas Pires with a through ball.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Burnley 2. Marcus Edwards (Burnley) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jaydon Banel.
Goal! Cardiff City 1, Burnley 2. Ollie Tanner (Cardiff City) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Rubin Colwill following a corner.
First Half ends, Cardiff City 1, Burnley 2.
